 The warm season lasts for 2.9 months, from June 13 to September 10, with an average daily high temperature above 71°F. The hottest month of the year in Paris is July, with an average high of 76°F and low of 58°F. 

 The cool season lasts for 3.7 months, from November 16 to March 7, with an average daily high temperature below 51°F. The coldest month of the year in Paris is January, with an average low of 36°F and high of 44°F.

# Paris Average Temperature by Month

This page shows the average temperature in each month of the year in Paris, France. It is based on NOAA data for the years 1991–2020.

- Change city
- Average precipitation by month

What's the Hottest Month in Paris?

In Paris, France, the warmest month is July, with an average daily high temperature of 25.8 °C and an average low of 15.0 °C.

What's the Coldest Month in Paris?

In Paris, France, the coolest month is January, with an average daily high temperature of 7.2 °C and an average low of 2.0 °C.

## Les douze mois en chiffres

Une normale est la moyenne d'une variable sur trente ans. L'Organisation météorologique mondiale retient la dernière période de trente ans terminée par un zéro, aujourd'hui 1991 à 2020, et c'est sur ces années que porte le tableau. La ligne du mois en cours est surlignée.
